title: Preflight STIM LaunchAgent Messages access
body: Resolve harness friction #53 by requiring a non-sending iMessage access preflight from the exact LaunchAgent execution context before enabling a reviewed schedule, with actionable Full Disk Access guidance.

log.text: Implementing LaunchAgent-context iMessage preflight and regression coverage for friction #53.
